headline: Nevish Line Burns Late as Expanse Battle Holds
war_summary: Three hours further on the wires find the Weathered Expanse edging past the Nevish Line for late traffic with five changes in two hours and fifty-three in the day about Crow's Nest, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk, standing one Warden to five Colonial with three neutral, against twelve thousand odd casualties in the day. The Nevish Line follows with four changes in two hours and forty-seven in the day about Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, now six Warden to two Colonial after 6,192 Colonial and 5,882 Warden casualties in the day. Kuura Strand adds two late changes and thirty-three in the day at Faden Point, holding one Warden to four Colonial with one neutral. Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow have fallen silent in the last two hours after eleven and thirty-two changes in the day at Lathair and Checkpoint Bua, while Stlican Shelf shows a fresh turn at Breaker Town. Callahan's Passage still shows sharp loss with 1,449 Colonial and 811 Warden casualties in two hours but no recorded flip.
